5e7420.title: 127.0.0.1 discovery blocked by scope proxy backend
5e7420.content:
Surface discovery specialist evidence for exact approved target `https://127.0.0.1/`:

- Proxy environment exposed `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, and `ALL_PROXY` at `http://127.0.0.1:48080`; inherited `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1` was explicitly cleared/overridden for command-line requests.
- Explicit-proxy httpx verification reached both `http://127.0.0.1/` and `https://127.0.0.1/`, each reporting HTTP 500, title `Caido`, content length 9088. Response body states: `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database`, with hint `Have you tried selecting a project first?` It is a proxy error page, not target content.
- Bounded Katana crawl: `-d 3 -ct 45s -jc -xhr -kf all -fs '(127\\.0\\.0\\.1)' -proxy http://127.0.0.1:48080`; result: 1 endpoint (only HTTPS root seed), HTTP 500 proxy page, no links, JS endpoints, XHRs, forms, APIs, redirects, or parameters.
- Required UI-only agent-browser check was repeated after closing a pre-existing daemon; new clean run used `--proxy http://127.0.0.1:48080 --proxy-bypass '' --allowed-domains 127.0.0.1 --ignore-https-errors`. Navigation request `GET https://127.0.0.1/` fails `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; no UI controls/forms/routes observed. No interaction or form submission occurred.
- Live scope captured-request journal queried after all requests: 0 entries for host `127.0.0.1`, so no raw journal exchange could be inspected.
- No redirects disclosed explicit non-default HTTP(S) ports; no port probing was performed. Raw command artifacts are at `/workspace/recon-evidence/` (headers/body, Katana JSONL/log, browser result files).

Exact unresolved gap: Scope proxy's backing repository/database is unavailable or no project is selected, preventing scoped forwarding and journaling; target surface cannot be mapped until that proxy configuration is restored.
